title: The kernel of a sheafified quotient is the subsheaf of sections locally in the image
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\varphi}\mathcal G$ be a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the presheaf $P$ by $P(V)=\mathcal G(V)/\varphi_V(\mathcal F(V))$ for each open $V\subseteq X$, and let $P^#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let $q:\mathcal G\to P^#$ be the composite. Then $\ker q$ is the subsheaf whose sections are locally in the image of $\varphi$, and consequently $q$ is an epimorphism and $q\circ\varphi=0$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AH (tag 01AH, modules.tex lines 204-243): colimits in modules are sheafified presheaf colimits; Sites, Theorem 00WB and Lemma 00WK give the local section/equality criterion used for the kernel.

proof.text: Write p for the presheaf cokernel projection and eta for the module sheafification unit. The canonical equation hq and cokernel.condition give phi followed by q equal to zero. Faithfulness of the forgetful functor transfers this equality to module sheaves.

The sheafification adjunction identifies maps from the sheafified cokernel with presheaf maps out of the cokernel. If two maps agree after q, cancel the epic cokernel projection p and use injectivity of sheafificationHomEquiv. Thus q is epic.

Evaluate the cokernel short complex on an open W. Evaluation preserves finite colimits, so ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel and ShortComplex.Exact.map give an exact complex of modules. By ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff any section killed by p_W lifts through phi_W.

If q_V(s)=0, the underlying additive-group sheafification unit sends p_V(s) and zero to the same section. Its Mathlib local injectivity instance and Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem give a covering equalizer sieve. Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology supplies a neighborhood W for each point; naturality of p and the evaluated exactness give the required preimage in F(W). Conversely, local preimages and the zero composite show q_V(s) restricts to zero on a covering sieve. Separatedness of the sheafified quotient gives q_V(s)=0.
